shopNote: Coins come from watching ads or buying coin packs. Upgrades you buy are permanent.
shopNote2: Packs are bought in the App Store and Google Play app. No real payment is taken on this test page.
adNote: Test ad. In the mobile app a real rewarded ad plays here. +100 coins when it ends.
hint: Touch anywhere and drag to walk. Get close to monsters and your weapons strike on their own; your cable drags in the dead and Serhat devours them.
story: Alien monsters kidnapped electrician Serhat's son and took him to the other side of the rift. Serhat straps on his cable and steps through the portal into their dimension. Every monster he devours gives him its power, every weapon it drops becomes his.
howWalkD: A joystick appears wherever you touch the screen; drag it (WASD on keyboard)
howAtkD: When a monster comes in range, all your weapons strike on their own
howEatD: Your cable pulls in the monsters you kill; Serhat devours them and takes their power
howToolD: Crowned commanders give electrician tools: screwdriver, utility knife, hatchet, saw… Up to 4 tools strike together
howKitD: Every boss drops insulated gloves, boots, a hard hat, a vest or a dielectric shield
howPowD: Everyone shows ⚡ power above their head: green is weaker than you, red is stronger
overStory: The portal will bring you back to the start of the island. Your health and shield are full; your tools and powers stay with you.
pl_saturn_sub: In the shadow of the rings
bossSub1: The creatures transformed them. Your son is in the cage on their back
cageBrokenSub: Devour the body and take the gear. Your son is on the next island
gateOpenSub: Cross the bridge to the next island
resumeHere: Picking up where you left off
startSub: Clear the camps, take tools from the commanders; the boss opens the gate
friendsEmpty: Link your account first to add friends. Give your code ({code}) to a friend so they can add you.
leagueNote: Weekly league: ranked by islands cleared and power score. It restarts every Monday; the top 3 win coins.
leagueEmpty: Other players' rankings appear once you link your account.
msgsEmpty: No messages yet. Link your account to message your friends; messages are translated automatically.
accNote: Sign in with the TusneldaX account you use in Electric Man. Your progress, coins and purchases are saved to the cloud so you can continue on another phone.
accDemo: Accounts can't be linked on this test page; it opens in the store app.
toastLink: Account linking opens in the store app (the same TusneldaX account as Electric Man).
toastFriend: Link your account first to add friends.
freeSlots: {n} empty tool slots. Beat the crowned commanders.
noKit: No gear yet. Every island's boss drops a piece.
reviewApp: The rating reward opens in the store app.
linkSoon: The link to this account is coming soon.
packsApp: Coin packs are bought in the store app. No payment is taken on this test page.

in1: Night. Electrician Serhat is fixing the neighbourhood's last fault. His son is playing ball in the yard.

in3: Bug-like aliens poured out of the rift… and seized his son!
in5: Serhat grabbed his cable and leapt into the portal after them.
